build_pixio_vitb16_model: build a Pixio ViT-B/16 vision transformer model with 768 embedding dimensions and 12 transformer blocks
build_pixio_vitl16_model: build a Pixio ViT-L/16 vision transformer model with 1024 embedding dimensions and 24 transformer blocks
build_pixio_vith16_model: build a Pixio ViT-H/16 vision transformer model with 1280 embedding dimensions and 32 transformer blocks
build_pixio_vit1b16_model: build a Pixio ViT-1B/16 vision transformer model with 1536 embedding dimensions and 48 transformer blocks
run_pixio_vit_forward: run forward pass on a PixioViT model to extract patch and cls tokens from specified transformer blocks
